name: Open workspace not showing name in the tab
description:
- **Problem:** Open workspace tabs displayed the generic app title ("Workspace") instead of the workspace's `name` property.
- **Root cause:** `workspaces.open()` never forwarded the resolved `name` on the normal branch, and `Tab.vue`'s `tabName` never consulted `this.app?.name`.
- **Fix 1:** In `navigate.js`, pass `{ workspace, name }` to `openApp('workspace', …)` so the panel/app carries the workspace name.
- **Fix 2:** In `Tab.vue`, added `this.app?.name` to the `tabName` fallback chain, placed after chat/board/workspace checks to avoid affecting other panel types.
- **Result:** Workspace tabs now show the correct `name`, while chat and board tab labels remain unchanged.
